source: Enshrouded game data (keen::ItemInfo, category Ammunition, ammunitionType Arrow/Spell; test, enemy, trap and firework items left out), decoded with kfc/decode.py; names from kfc/items/items_all.json. Built by tmp/ammo/build_ammo.py. analysis/ammo.md has the read path.
key: items: ItemInfo.itemId (decimal), the value at ImpactItemConfig + 0x1C (ammunitionItem.itemId) of the impact entity that ran the hit. templates: projectile template GUID (ItemInfo.equipment.placedEntity), for reference; the read path does not yield it.
